# AMEVA-Sentinel (v0.6.0-alpha.1) Complete LLM Specification & Feed

> Official Canonical Guide for LLMs and Autonomous Agents
> Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-sentinel
> Version: v0.6.0-alpha.1
> License: Apache-2.0

## Target Discrimination Modes
- ANY: General risk scoring and category routing.
- HUMANS_ONLY: Automated tools and unverified bots are strictly challenged / denied.
- BOTS_ONLY: Interactive humans are redirected to bot guidance / LLM feed (/llms.txt).
- VERIFIED_PARTNERS_ONLY: Only cryptographically verified sv1 tokens signed by authorized key rings are permitted.

## 7-Tier Bot Classification Taxonomy
1. SEARCH_ENGINE: Googlebot, Bingbot, YandexBot, DuckDuckBot, Baiduspider, Yahoo! Slurp, Applebot, NaverBot, Yeti
2. AI_AGENT: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Anthropic-AI, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Cohere-AI, Omgilibot, Bytespider, Diffbot
3. SOCIAL_PREVIEW: Twitterbot, FacebookExternalHit, LinkedInBot, Slackbot, TelegramBot, Discordbot, WhatsApp, Pinterest, Apple-PubSub
4. MONITORING: UptimeRobot, Pingdom, Better Uptime, Datadog, NewRelicPinger, Site24x7, StatusCake, AWS Network Health, Catchpoint
5. FEED_FETCHER: FeedParser, Tiny Tiny RSS, Feedly, NewsBlur, Inoreader, FreshRSS, Miniflux, Reeder
6. AUTOMATED_TOOL: curl, wget, python-requests, python-urllib, aiohttp, httpx, Scrapy, Axios, Go-http-client, Java, libwww-perl, PostmanRuntime, Insomnia, Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, HeadlessChrome, PhantomJS, Nightwatch
7. UNKNOWN_BOT: Generic crawler/spider tokens not belonging to known categories

## Cryptographic Envelope (sv1)
Format: `sv1.<payload_b64>.<signature_b64>`
- payload: Canonical JSON subset `{ v: 1, kid, iss, aud, purpose, sessionRef, iat, exp, nonce }`
- signature: HMAC-SHA256(`secretKey`, `sv1.${payload_b64}`)
